entries: When {DISASTER:strikes} is remembered in {place}, {first}, a {trait} {job}, must {DO_THING} {THING} {DEADLINE}, or someone will stay unquiet.

To free {SOMEONE:human,!plural} of {DISASTER}, {first}, a {trait} {job}, must find {THING:portable} {DEADLINE}.

At {landmark:built}, {first}, a {trait} {job}, discovers that {SOMEONE:human,!plural} has been waiting {DEADLINE}.
